description: Test dependencies for npm/spectype; the published package has none.

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path ../bindings/spectype_napi/Cargo.toml --package-json-path spectype/package.json --output-dir spectype --js binding.cjs --dts binding.d.cts --no-dts-header
scripts.build:wasm: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path ../bindings/spectype_napi/Cargo.toml --package-json-path spectype/package.json --target wasm32-wasip1 --output-dir platforms/wasm32-wasip1 --no-js --dts ../../spectype/binding.d.cts --no-dts-header && cd platforms/wasm32-wasip1 && rm -f browser.js *-browser.js *-deferred.* *.d.cts *.debug.wasm
